$description: The Phase 4 migration list (Plenix Styling Standard, section 6): parts that change the font family without the whole text role. It only shrinks: node check-system.rules/text-contract.js --shrink.

parts.plx-brand-lockup__app: changes the font family without the whole role (missing font-size, letter-spacing)
parts.plx-brand-lockup__name: changes the font family without the whole role (missing font-size)
parts.plx-data-pill--data: changes the font family without the whole role (missing font-size, letter-spacing)
parts.plx-image-editor__text: changes the font family without the whole role (missing letter-spacing, line-height)
parts.plx-image-editor__text--bold: changes the font family without the whole role (missing letter-spacing, line-height)
parts.plx-inline-edit__read: changes the font family without the whole role (its font and word spacing are not one switch)
parts.plx-input-group__affix: changes the font family without the whole role (its font and word spacing are not one switch)
parts.plx-link: changes the font family without the whole role (missing font-size, letter-spacing, line-height)
parts.plx-link--standalone: changes the font family without the whole role (missing font-size, letter-spacing, line-height)
parts.plx-popover: changes the font family without the whole role (missing font-weight, letter-spacing)
parts.plx-session-timeout__time: changes the font family without the whole role (missing font-size, letter-spacing, line-height)
